Simple table populates the tables array in result

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"include_document_structure":true}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Age</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Alice</td><td>30</td></tr></tbody></table>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
    stdout.writeln(result.tables);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
